params.blurb: {{sbc|Innate:}} {{ci|Ivern}} cannot attack nor damage non-epic {{tip|monsters}}. When he targets a jungle camp, he {{tip|channel|plants}} a magical {{as|grove|buzzword2}} under it at the cost of {{as|health}} and {{as|mana}}.
params.blurb2: The {{as|grove|buzzword2}} charges up over time to fully mature, upon which '''Ivern''' can then target the monsters to instantly clear the camp. Using {{si|Smite}} on a monster in the {{as|grove|buzzword2}} will clear the camp regardless of maturity.
params.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Ivern''' cannot attack nor damage non-epic {{tip|monster|monsters}}. Instead, targeting a jungle camp initiates a {{fd|2.5}} second {{tip|channel}} that will plant a {{as|grove|buzzword2}} upon the camp. Placing a {{as|grove|buzzword2}} costs {{sti|health|{{as|{{pplevel|(15-(x-1)*0.882)/100*({{ccd|Ivern|hp_base}}+{{ccd|Ivern|hp_lvl}}*(x-1)*(0.7025+0.0175*(x-1)))|formula = (15% - 0.882% per level after 1) of base health}} health}}}} and {{sti|mana|{{as|{{pplevel|(20-(x-1)*1.175)/100*({{ccd|Ivern|mp_base}}+{{ccd|Ivern|mp_lvl}}*(x-1)*(0.7025+0.0175*(x-1)))|formula = (20% - 1.175% per level after 1) of base mana}} mana}}}}. The channel cannot be cancelled in the first {{fd|0.15}} seconds and in the last {{fd|0.5}} seconds.
params.description2: '''''Ivern''' cannot place a grove while he is affected by {{tip|cast-inhibiting crowd control}} or a {{tip|lockout}} that disables abilities.''
params.description3: The {{as|grove|buzzword2}} matures over {{pp|40;38;36;34;32;30;27;24;21;18;15;11;7;3;1|formula = 42 - 2 per level until level 6, then 3 until level 11, then 4 until level 15. ''This is capped at 1 second at level 15.''}} seconds. When fully matured, '''Ivern''' can target the camp again to ''free'' it after a {{fd|0.5}}-second [[cast time]], clearing the camp and receiving the {{tt|{{g|full gold}} and {{sti|experience|{{as|full experience}}}}|Not full when freeing Krug camp, see notes}} [[bounty|bounties]]. Using {{si|Smite}} on a monster within the {{as|grove|buzzword2}} will instantly ''free'' the camp regardless of maturity.
params.description4: If the camp's large monster has already been slain prior to planting a {{as|grove|buzzword2}}, '''Ivern''' will ''free'' the camp upon completing the channel at no cost. Similarly, the {{as|grove|buzzword2}} will instantly mature if the large monster is slain.
params.notes:
* Freeing the {{ui|Ancient Krug|Krug camp}} will only grant the {{g|gold}} and {{sti|{{as|experience}}}} of 1 {{ui|Ancient Krug}}, 2 {{ui|Krug|Krugs}}, and 3 {{ui|Krug|Mini Krugs}}.
* '''Ivern''' must be within {{tip|er|icononly = true}} 275 units of the {{tt|large monster|if still alive}} of the targeted camp to start channeling or collect a {{as|grove|buzzword2}}. The large monsters also must be {{tip|sight|visible}}.
* If '''Ivern''' cannot afford the cost to place a grove, ''Friend of the Forest'' is placed on a cooldown equal to the number of seconds it takes for his {{as|{{sti|health regeneration}}}} and/or {{as|{{sti|mana regeneration}}}} to restore him to the amount of health and/or mana needed to afford the cost.
** The cooldown will update based on '''Ivern's''' '''current''' health and mana regeneration, as well as his '''current''' health and mana.
* If '''Ivern's''' level is 19 or higher, he will be {{tip|heal|healed}} and receive {{as|mana}} when placing a {{as|grove|buzzword2}}.
* ''Friend of the Forest'' can be used while '''Ivern''' or the camp is in combat and, once the {{as|grove|buzzword2}} is placed, {{si|Smite}} can be used to instantly claim the camp. {{tip|Interrupt|Interrupting}} '''Ivern's''' channel is the only way to contest jungle camps, short of killing the camp during the channel time.
* Freeing a {{as|grove|buzzword2}} causes the monsters within the camp to be dealt {{as|5000 true damage}} in the {{tip|raw damage|internalraw damage}} source type by '''Ivern''', despite his inability to damage them.
* ''Friend of the Forest'' will leave '''Ivern''' at {{as|1 health}} if cast with exactly the required amount. ''Friend of the Forest'' cannot be cast with less, unlike other abilities with health costs.
* Non-epic monsters can attack '''Ivern''' if his allies enter combat with the monster and he manages to receive aggro.{{bug}}
** {{ui|Voidmite|Voidmites}} uses the allied healthbar-colours whilst still being able to be damaged by '''Ivern'''.{{bug}}
* The following table refers for interactions while '''Ivern''' is {{tip|channel|channeling}}:
** '''Ivern''' is unable to act during the first {{fd|0.15}} and last {{fd|0.5}} seconds of the channel.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Ivern}} throws a vine in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|root|roots}} the first enemy hit.
params.blurb2: While the target is rooted, '''Ivern''' can recast ''Rootcaller''. He and his allies can select the target to {{tip|dash}} closer to the location.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Ivern''' throws a vine in the target direction, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to the first enemy hit and {{tip|root|rooting}} them for a duration, during which they are also {{tip|standard sight|revealed}}. ''Rootcaller'' can be recast while the target is {{tip|root|rooted}}.
params.leveling:
{{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|80 to 260}} {{as|(+ 70% AP)}}}}
{{st|Root Duration|{{ap|1.6 to 2}} seconds}}
params.description2: '''Ivern''' and allied champions can issue an {{tt|attack order|Default: MB2 / right-click}} against the target {{tip|root|rooted}} by ''Rootcaller'' to {{tip|dash}} to their location, stopping at {{sti|their attack range}}.
params.description4: Hitting a non-epic monster reduces ''Rootcaller's'' {{sti|cooldown}} by 50%.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Passive:}} While {{ci|Ivern}} is in {{tip|brush}}, his basic attacks deal {{as|'''additional''' magic damage|magic damage}}.
params.blurb2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Ivern''' grows a patch of {{tip|brush}} at the target location. More brush will be created if grown near [[terrain]] or other brush.
params.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} While '''Ivern''' is in {{tip|brush}}, his basic attacks are empowered to fire a bolt at the target, dealing {{as|'''additional''' magic damage|magic damage}}. This bonus persists for 3 seconds after leaving brush.
params.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Ivern''' grows a patch of {{tip|brush}} at the target location for 45 seconds, granting {{tip|sight}} of the area within and around it for 8 seconds. Brushes despawn instantly after allied {{tip|sight|vision}} within them is lost. Spawning brush near [[terrain]] or other brush increases its radius.
params.description3: While allied champions are in any {{tip|brush}} when '''Ivern''' is within {{tt|1000|Estimated}} units, their basic attacks are empowered to fire a bolt at the target, dealing {{as|'''additional''' magic damage|magic damage}}. This bonus persists for {{fd|1.5}} seconds after leaving brush.
params.leveling3: {{st|Ally Additional Magic Damage|{{ap|10 to 30}} {{as|(+ 10% of '''Ivern's''' AP)}}}}<!--not on-hit-->
params.description4: '''Ivern''' periodically [[stocks]] a ''Brushmaker'' charge, up to a maximum of 3.
params.speed: 3500 <!--it says 3000 somewhere in the data so not sure-->
params.notes:
* The additional damage does not apply to structures.
* The empowerment given to allies respects {{tip|enchantment redirection}}.
* A {{tip|brush}} is immediately {{tip|expose|exposed}} if grown within an enemy {{tip|turret|turret's}} {{tip|sight}} radius of {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} 1350.
* Epic monsters can not be concealed within {{tip|brush}}.
** However, it is still possible to deny enemy vision of their area by creating walls of {{tip|brush}} at their line of sight.
* {{ai|Brushmaker|Ivern}} ''locks on'' allies when hovered.
* The indicator for {{ai|Brushmaker|Ivern|Brushmaker's}} cast range has a radius of 1150, where the maximum cast range takes the {{tip|brush|brush's}} edge, rather than center, into consideration.
params.tips:
* Abilities which utilises {{tip|Brush}} (e.g. {{Cai|Headshot|Caitlyn}}, {{cai|Sapling Toss|Maokai}}, {{Cai|Unseen Predator|Rengar}}) can take full advantage of {{Ai|Brushmaker|Ivern}}.
* The additional damage can give you gold from support quest on support item.
* The vision in and around the placed {{tip|brush}} lingers for 8 seconds, making it an excellent scouting tool when checking {{tip|brush}}, or neutral objectives for enemies.
* Vision control is extremely important in League of Legends. Depending on the {{Tip|Brush}} placement it could allow for a normally poor roam/recall timer to become surprisingly efficient, increase safety from poke/ganks/sieges, or create highly effective gank-/counter-gank opportunities.
* {{tip|Brush}} close to/under allied {{tip|turret|turrets}} will linger for its full duration since a non-destroyed allied {{tip|turret}} always grants Ivern {{tip|sight}} around it.
** A {{tip|brush}} Ivern isn't physically standing in will despawn if he is affected by {{tip|nearsight}} after the initial 8 seconds of {{ai|Brushmaker|Ivern|Brushmaker's}} {{tip|sight}} has passed, even if he has vision inside it through allied {{tip|sight}}.
* Placing {{tip|Brush}}, and a {{tip|Stealth Ward}} inside it in a non-allied zone of the map allows the {{tip|Brush}} to linger for its full duration, which can create the illusion of more allies being close by (sometimes referred to as 'fake pressure').
* While in combat, placing {{tip|Brush}} in front of where you are running allows you to hide for a short moment, stopping enemy champions from targeting you until they regain vision.
** This can be utilised offensively aswell. A {{tip|Brush}} on/in front of allies can conceal engage tools and 'skillshots', catching unprepared enemies off-guard.
* Since {{tip|Control Ward|Control Wards}} require line of sight to reveal/{{tip|Disabled Ward|disable}} [[File:Ward icon.png|20px|link=]] ''wards'', {{tip|stealthed trap|traps}}, and {{tip|Camouflage|Camouflaged}} champions, placing a {{tip|Brush}} either on top of-, or in-between the hidden unit and the {{tip|Control Ward|Control Ward}} hides- and/or re-enables it for the lifetime of the brush.
** Similarly you can prevent enemy vision altogether by placing a {{tip|brush}} between the [[File:Ward icon.png|20px|link=]] ''ward'' and the objective.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Ivern}} can target an ally champion, {{ui|Daisy}}, or himself to {{tip|shield}} them for a short time.
params.blurb2: The target then explodes to deal {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|slow}} nearby enemies.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Ivern''' places a seed on the target allied champion, {{ui|Daisy}}, or himself, granting the target a {{tip|shield}} for 2 seconds.
params.description2: After 2 seconds, the seed explodes to deal {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies and {{tip|slow}} them for 2 seconds.
params.description3: If the seed does not damage an enemy champion and the shield persists by the end of the duration, the shield is reapplied for the same strength and duration without the explosion effect.
params.notes:
* The explosion occurs regardless of whether the shield is maintained.
* The damage of ''Triggerseed'' is attributed to the champion the shield was cast on.
** If cast on {{ui|Daisy}} or himself, the damage is attributed to '''Ivern'''.
** The {{tip|slow}} debuff is always attributed to '''Ivern'''.
** Therefore, placing ''Triggerseed'' on allied champions:
*** grants them credit for all [[kill]]s on enemy units that it causes.
*** triggers turret aggro on them if it deals damage to an enemy champion.
*** triggers their spell effects instead of '''Ivern's'''.
*** benefits from their {{sti|{{as|magic penetration}}}} stat.
** '''Ivern's''' player can appreciate the damage ''Triggerseed'' from an ally deals via a yellow damage number intended to reflect the damage dealt.
*** This yellow damage number uses '''Ivern's''' {{sti|{{as|magic penetration}}}} stat to calculate the expected damage dealt, instead of reflecting the actual damage dealt.{{bug}}

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Ivern}} summons his Sentinel friend {{ui|Daisy}} to fight with him.
params.blurb2: ''Daisy!'' can be recast any number of times while {{ui|Daisy}} is alive. The recast cannot be {{tip|interrupt|interrupted}}.
params.blurb3: {{sbc|Recast:}} {{ui|Daisy}} is commanded to move to the target location. If recast on '''Ivern''', she will follow him.
params.blurb4: {{sbc|Daisy Smash!:}} Whenever {{ui|Daisy}} attacks the same champion three times in a row, she will send a shockwave that {{tip|airborne|knocks up}} enemies hit within a line.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Ivern''' summons his sentinel friend {{ui|Daisy}} to his side, who lands 350 units away from him in the target direction and remains on the field for up to 45 seconds as a controllable {{tip|pet}}.
params.description2: ''Daisy!'' can be recast at any time while {{ui|Daisy}} is alive.
params.description3: {{sbc|Recast - Daisy, wait!:}} '''Ivern''' commands {{ui|Daisy}} to move to the target location. If cast on '''Ivern''', {{ui|Daisy}} will follow him.
params.description4: ''The recast of Daisy! can be used while affected by {{tip|cast-inhibiting crowd control}}. See [[Ivern#Pets|Pets]] for more details about {{ui|Daisy}}.''
params.notes:
* Only the initial cast counts as an ability activation for the purposes of on-cast effects such as {{tip|Spellblade}}<!-- and triggering {{ais|Force Pulse|Kassadin}} passive-->.
** Recasting the ability does, however, count as casting an ultimate ability for the purposes of {{iis|Experimental Hexplate}} {{nie|Overdrive}} and similar effects.{{bug}}
** {{pending for test}} What about {{ais|Force Pulse|Kassadin}}?
* ''Daisy'', when the ability is initially cast, is {{tip|untargetable}} until she lands.
* Recasting ''Daisy!'' does not interrupt {{sis|Recall}} channel.
